sentences.text: Pieris napi has been recorded eating Oregano (Origanum vulgare).
It has been recorded visiting the flowers of Oregano, Garlic Mustard, Red Dead-nettle, Purple Loosestrife, Daisy, Devil's-Bit Scabious, and Black Horehound.
In the Mainz-Bingen region it is mainly reported between April and September, with peaks in April and July.
